# FRDM-i.MX95: free and full profiles

These features need artifacts that nixpkgs does not allow with `allowUnfree = false`, so only the full profile includes them. Blocked artifacts are not packaged in any profile.

## boot-firmware

| Features | Artifact | Class | Available in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| frdm-imx95-boot-container | `frdm-imx95.complete-boot-container` | R2 | full |
| frdm-imx95-boot-container | `frdm-imx95.complete-boot-container-provider` | R2 | full |
| frdm-imx95-boot-container | `frdm-imx95.ele-firmware` | R2 | full |
| frdm-imx95-boot-container | `frdm-imx95.lpddr4x-dmem` | R2 | full |
| frdm-imx95-boot-container | `frdm-imx95.lpddr4x-dmem-qb` | R2 | full |
| frdm-imx95-boot-container | `frdm-imx95.lpddr4x-imem` | R2 | full |
| frdm-imx95-boot-container | `frdm-imx95.lpddr4x-imem-qb` | R2 | full |
| frdm-imx95-boot-container, frdm-imx95-m7-remoteproc | `frdm-imx95.source-boot-container` | R2 | full |
